passages.text: A Psalm of David, when he was in the Wilderness of Judah.
passages.sermon: David wrote this psalm.\r\nDavid was in the Wilderness of Judah.

passages.text: O God, You are my God. Earnestly I seek You; my soul thirsts for You. My body yearns for You in a dry and weary land without water.
passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm.
David was in the wilderness of Judah.
God, You are my God.
I seek You earnestly.
My soul thirsts for You.
My body longs for You.
I am in a dry and weary land.
This land has no water.
passages.original: מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִ֑ד בִּ֝הְיוֹת֗וֹ בְּמִדְבַּ֥ר יְהוּדָֽה׃ אֱלֹהִ֤ים׀ אֵלִ֥י אַתָּ֗ה אֲ‍ֽשַׁחֲ֫רֶ֥ךָּ צָמְאָ֬ה לְךָ֨׀ נַפְשִׁ֗י כָּמַ֣הּ לְךָ֣ בְשָׂרִ֑י בְּאֶֽרֶץ־ צִיָּ֖ה וְעָיֵ֣ף בְּלִי־ מָֽיִם׃

passages.text: So I have seen You in the sanctuary and beheld Your power and glory.
passages.sermon:
David was in the Wilderness of Judah.
David wrote this psalm.
David spoke to God.
David said he saw God in the sanctuary.
David saw God's power.
David saw God's glory.
passages.original: כֵּ֭ן בַּקֹּ֣דֶשׁ חֲזִיתִ֑יךָ לִרְא֥וֹת עֻ֝זְּךָ֗ וּכְבוֹדֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: Because Your loving devotion is better than life, my lips will glorify You.
passages.sermon:
God shows loving devotion.
God’s loving devotion is better than life.
I will glorify God with my lips.
passages.original: כִּי־ ט֣וֹב חַ֭סְדְּךָ מֵֽחַיִּ֗ים שְׂפָתַ֥י יְשַׁבְּחֽוּנְךָ׃

passages.text: So I will bless You as long as I live; in Your name I will lift my hands.
passages.sermon:
David speaks to God.
David promises to bless God.
David will bless God throughout his life.
David will lift his hands to God.
David will lift his hands in God's name.
passages.original: כֵּ֣ן אֲבָרֶכְךָ֣ בְחַיָּ֑י בְּ֝שִׁמְךָ אֶשָּׂ֥א כַפָּֽי׃

passages.text: My soul is satisfied as with the richest of foods; with joyful lips my mouth will praise You.
passages.sermon:
David speaks to God.
David says his soul feels satisfied.
His soul feels satisfied like after eating the richest foods.
David’s mouth praises God.
His lips are joyful as he praises God.
passages.original: כְּמ֤וֹ חֵ֣לֶב וָ֭דֶשֶׁן תִּשְׂבַּ֣ע נַפְשִׁ֑י וְשִׂפְתֵ֥י רְ֝נָנ֗וֹת יְהַלֶּל־ פִּֽי׃

passages.text: When I remember You on my bed, I think of You through the watches of the night.
passages.sermon:
David speaks to God.
David remembers God while he lies on his bed.
David thinks about God during the night.
David meditates on God through every watch of the night.
passages.original: אִם־ זְכַרְתִּ֥יךָ עַל־ יְצוּעָ֑י בְּ֝אַשְׁמֻר֗וֹת אֶהְגֶּה־ בָּֽךְ׃

passages.text: For You are my help; I will sing for joy in the shadow of Your wings.
passages.sermon:
God helps me.
God protects me.
God covers me with His wings.
I sing with joy because God keeps me safe.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ הָיִ֣יתָ עֶזְרָ֣תָה לִּ֑י וּבְצֵ֖ל כְּנָפֶ֣יךָ אֲרַנֵּֽן׃

passages.text: My soul clings to You; Your right hand upholds me.
passages.sermon: David speaks to God.\r\nDavid’s soul clings to God.\r\nGod’s right hand upholds David.
passages.original: דָּבְקָ֣ה נַפְשִׁ֣י אַחֲרֶ֑יךָ בִּ֝֗י תָּמְכָ֥ה יְמִינֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: But those who seek my life to destroy it will go into the depths of the earth.
passages.sermon:
Some people want to destroy me.
They seek my life.
God will judge them.
They will go down into the depths of the earth.
passages.original: וְהֵ֗מָּה לְ֭שׁוֹאָה יְבַקְשׁ֣וּ נַפְשִׁ֑י יָ֝בֹ֗אוּ בְּֽתַחְתִּיּ֥וֹת הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: They will fall to the power of the sword; they will become a portion for foxes.
passages.sermon:
David speaks about his enemies.
His enemies attack him.
They will die by the sword.
Foxes will eat their bodies.
passages.original: יַגִּירֻ֥הוּ עַל־ יְדֵי־ חָ֑רֶב מְנָ֖ת שֻׁעָלִ֣ים יִהְיֽוּ׃

passages.text: But the king will rejoice in God; all who swear by Him will exult, for the mouths of liars will be shut.
passages.sermon:
David is the king.
David will rejoice in God.
Everyone who swears by God will praise Him.
God will silence the mouths of liars.
passages.original: וְהַמֶּלֶךְ֮ יִשְׂמַ֪ח בֵּאלֹ֫הִ֥ים יִ֭תְהַלֵּל כָּל־ הַנִּשְׁבָּ֣ע בּ֑וֹ כִּ֥י יִ֝סָּכֵ֗ר פִּ֣י דֽוֹבְרֵי־ שָֽׁקֶר׃
